title.en: AN ACT TO ENCOURAGE THE SHIPPING TRADE IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS BY ABOLISHING THE COLLECTION OF ALL TONNAGE DUES ON VESSELS COMING FROM FOREIGN PORTS TO PORTS OF ENTRY IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS.
title.orig: AN ACT TO ENCOURAGE THE SHIPPING TRADE IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS BY ABOLISHING THE COLLECTION OF ALL TONNAGE DUES ON VESSELS COMING FROM FOREIGN PORTS TO PORTS OF ENTRY IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS.

text.en:
The provisions respecting tonnage dues on the entry of a vessel  from  a  port or place not  in
Philippine Islands  contained in sections fourteen and fifteen of Act Numbered Two  hundred and thirty,
entitled " An Act to revise tariffs laws of the Philippine Archipelago,"enacted by the Philippine Commission
on September seventeenth, nineteen hundred and one, nineteen hundred and two, are hereby repealed.

The public good requiring the speedy bill, the passage of the same is hereby expedited section two
of "An Act prescribing the order o Commission in the enactment of laws," passed sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on September first, nineteen hundred and six.
Enacted, August 31, 1906.
